decisions.statement: A download whose MD5 disagrees with the catalog's is not installed.
Only the outdated addons are updated unless the call forces every one.
An `--only` folder that is no installable addon is refused by name.
One addon that fails does not stop the rest.
Every addon that failed is named in the refusal rather than counted alone.
A folder the deploy pipeline owns is never touched.
Nothing here reports a change without making that change.
A folder laid down before its group threw is named updated rather than failed.
A folder the archive carried nothing for is named failed rather than left out.
A folder cleared whose new one never landed is named gone rather than left as it was.
A folder that was never cleared is refused as the fault alone.

definition: the command installing the published updates for the third-party game addons already here
